name: Networking and applications tracker
tagline: One dashboard for every contact, application and follow-up in my recruiting search.
summary: My master dashboard for recruiting. Agents watch email, Slack, LinkedIn and WhatsApp for new connections, job openings and things I owe people, then rank the action items and draft follow-ups for me to review.
problem: MBA recruiting spreads across inboxes, group chats and portals, and follow-ups slip through the cracks.
how: Integrations read new messages and posts from each source.
A job scraper agent pulls openings worth pursuing.
A follow-up agent spots action items and drafts replies (drafts only, never sent).
A research agent finds articles to mention when reconnecting with a contact.
A Streamlit dashboard shows everything in one ranked list.
highlights: Personal data is redacted everywhere it's shown or logged
